summary: Medtronic said Monday it has received a CE mark for its Vitalis portfolio of cardiac pacemakers. The portfolio features five devices, which Medtronic said offer a comprehensive suite of pacing options and include features for conduction system pacing therapy, or CSP. Medtronic named ReSyncra CSP as the most advanced device, highlighting its suitability for use in patients who may benefit from cardiac resynchronization therapy, or CRT, but are failed by traditional approaches to treatment.
